changePlan.q: Can I change plans at any time?
changePlan.a: Yes. You can upgrade or downgrade whenever you want. The change applies at the start of the next billing period.

commissions.q: Are there commissions on my sales?
commissions.a: We charge no commission on your sales. You only pay your subscription and your payment gateway fees (Stripe, MercadoPago, etc.).

freeLimit.q: What happens if I exceed the order limit on the Free plan?
freeLimit.a: Your catalog stays active, but new orders are queued. We notify you so you can upgrade without losing orders.

tryPro.q: Can I try the Pro plan before paying?
tryPro.a: All paid plans include a 14-day free trial with no credit card.

annual.a: Annual billing is charged once at the start of the year. You save up to 33% compared to the monthly price.

cancel.q: Can I cancel at any time?
cancel.a: Yes. If you cancel, your plan stays active until the end of the paid period. No penalties.

try.q: Can I try the agency plan before paying?
try.a: Yes. You get a 14-day trial with up to 5 active catalogs and no credit card.

billing.q: How do I bill my clients?
billing.a: You set your price. We charge you the agency plan and you charge each client whatever you want. No interference.

whitelabel.q: Can I hide the WaCommerce brand?
whitelabel.a: Yes. On the Professional and Agency Growth plans you can use your own logo, domain and colors on the storefront and transactional emails.

extra.q: What if I need more catalogs than the plan?
extra.a: You can add extra catalogs at a reduced unit price. You can also upgrade your plan at any time.

owner.q: Can I give access to the business owner?
owner.a: Yes. There's a "client_owner" role that lets the owner see orders and analytics, without being able to change the catalog settings.
